spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact shipped surface from Chromium IDL (html_camera_element.idl / html_microphone_element.idl + the HTMLMediaCaptureElementBase and HTMLMediaTrackElementBase mixins): interface existence, parser construction identity, track/error/ontrack/onerror/oncancel, setConstraints(), and the stream/onstream absence that distinguishes single-capability elements from <usermedia>.

interactive.rationale: Probe button re-runs every check live; real <camera>/<microphone> markup sits in the page and the probe reports what the parser actually constructed for it.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the exact-member probe plus the HTMLUnknownElement trap; both delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Teaches the tag-sniffing trap explicitly: createElement('camera') yields an HTMLUnknownElement object on unsupported engines, so only instanceof against the real interface proves support. The <usermedia> comparison row needs its own flag and is labelled so.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5153829504024576, the mediacapture-extensions spec section, the explainer, and the exact Chromium IDL files.

conformance.rationale: The suite's interface/track/capture-base/setConstraints/distinction assertions are these rows as self-contained checks.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: probe correctly reports NOT SUPPORTED with 'parser constructed HTMLUnknownElement' on both viewports; conformance panel honestly shows 1 pass (constraint vocabulary) / 6 fail; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: capelem-probe-ran asserts per run with the supported flag and constructed type.

design_system.rationale: yes/no verdicts emerald/rose on near-white rows (AA); table scrolls in .tbl-wrap; CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Real table with caption and scoped column headers; textual yes/no verdicts; status is role=status aria-live; native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Table owns horizontal scroll; 0px page overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Re-probe on a CameraAndMicrophoneElements-enabled build
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141 predates the elements entirely (the flag can't resurrect uncompiled code), so the supported path — parser constructing HTMLCameraElement and all member rows going green — needs a Chrome 153+ run to capture.

guidanceConsulted.query: feature detect unsupported html element honest fallback banner
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Detect capability precisely and surface honest state rather than hiding failures.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: instanceof-based detection (not tag sniffing), explicit unsupported status with real flag steps.

guidanceConsulted.query: data table semantics scope caption screen reader
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Result matrices are real tables with textual verdicts.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native table, caption, scoped headers, text yes/no.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): every probe row is a live check against the IDL-exact surface, the HTMLUnknownElement trap is demonstrated with the parser's real output, and the unsupported state on Chromium 141 is reported honestly with working flag guidance.
